tools.name: cards_get-all
tools.description: Returns a `List` object that contains all cards in Scryfall’s database. This method is paginated, returning 175 cards at a time. The cards are ordered roughly newest to oldest. Optional: page, format, pretty.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to return, default 1.

params.name: format
params.description: The data format to return. This method only supports `json`.

params.name: pretty
params.description: If true, the returned JSON will be prettified. Avoid using for production code.

tools.name: sets_get-by-code
tools.description: Returns a `Set` with the given set code. The code can be either the `code` or the `mtgo_code` for the set. Required: code. Optional: format, pretty.

params.name: code
params.description: The three to five-letter set code.

params.name: format
params.description: The data format to return. This method only supports `json`.

params.name: pretty
params.description: If true, the returned JSON will be prettified. Avoid using for production code.
